Hypt OST Available for Sale!
notes.notes:
For those of you who enjoyed listening to the music while blasting and reflecting your way through Hypt's labyrinths, the original soundtrack composed by Efe Tozan has been made available for purchase from Hypt's steam storefront page. 

In commemoration of this event, Hypt's price has also been reduced.

Check it out!
